backed.name: Backed Finance
backed.structure: Swiss public limited company (Aktiengesellschaft); issues tracker certificates (xStocks / bTokens) over single stocks, ETFs and bonds, backed 1:1 by the underlying held with regulated custodians
backed.about: The dominant tokenized-equity issuer in these lists (7,790 rows). xStocks are tracker certificates issued as ERC-20 and Solana SPL tokens; the holder owns a claim on the certificate, not the underlying share. Governed by Swiss law.
backed.source: Backed Finance AG Zug commercial register (UID CHE-410.125.970); backed.fi structure page; Backed NVDAx factsheet

ondo.name: Ondo Global Markets
ondo.structure: Bankruptcy-remote SPV in the British Virgin Islands; tokenized stocks are structured notes (debt instruments) governed by Swiss law under the Issuer's Sales Terms; Regulation S
ondo.country: British Virgin Islands (issuer); parent Ondo Finance Inc is US
ondo.about: Issues 'Ondo Stocks' (tokenized stocks, ETFs and ADRs) as structured notes backed 1:1 (plus buffer) by the underlying securities held via a regulated custodial broker-dealer, with a first-priority security interest for tokenholders held by a security agent. 90.01% owned by Flux Finance Inc (subsidiary of the Ondo Foundation), 9.99% by Ondo Finance Inc. Offered only to non-US persons under Reg S.
ondo.source: Ondo legal & regulatory docs (issuer, ownership, Swiss-law Sales Terms, Reg S)

dinari.name: Dinari
dinari.structure: US broker-dealer registered with the SEC and a FINRA member; dShares are backed 1:1 by underlying US stocks/ETFs held by a registered US broker-dealer custodian
dinari.about: Issues dShares, tokenized representations of US stocks and ETFs backed 1:1 by the underlying securities held in custody.
dinari.source: Dinari disclosures page (Dinari Securities, LLC SEC/FINRA broker-dealer); OnChain Benchmark issuer profile

coinbase.name: Coinbase (Tokenized Stocks)
coinbase.structure: Special-purpose vehicle incorporated in the Abu Dhabi Global Market; bankruptcy-remote structure supervised by ADGM FSRA; underlying shares held by Alpaca (regulated broker/custodian); B20 standard on Base
coinbase.about: Coinbase Tokenized Stocks on Base: the token represents a beneficial interest in a pool of real shares held by a regulated custodian in a bankruptcy-remote ADGM structure. A third-party 'wrapper' — the underlying companies did not consent to tokenization — and not available to US persons.
coinbase.source: Coinbase Onchain SPV Ltd prospectus (ADGM FSMR 2015); Base launch blog; Galaxy Research Aug 2026

robinhood.name: Robinhood (Stock Tokens)
robinhood.structure: Jersey company issuing tokenised debt securities under a base prospectus
robinhood.about: Robinhood Stock Tokens are tokenized debt securities issued by Robinhood Assets (Jersey) Limited, linked to 200+ US stocks and ETFs.
robinhood.source: Robinhood RHJ base prospectus (25 June 2026, Robinhood Assets (Jersey) Limited)

bstocks.name: bStocks (Binance)
bstocks.structure: Private company limited by shares incorporated in the Abu Dhabi Global Market; certificates over shares representing a beneficial interest
bstocks.about: Binance's bStocks are tokenized securities on BNB Chain tracking US stocks and ETFs, admitted to the ADGM official list; structured as certificates over shares.
bstocks.source: BTECH Holdings Ltd prospectus (ADGM); Binance bStocks FAQ

backpack.name: Backpack Securities
backpack.entity: Trek Nexus Markets Ltd (issuer/bare trustee, BVI); broker Backpack Securities Global Limited (New Zealand)
backpack.structure: BVI bare trust over a pooled holding of the referenced shares; the token is a 'non-negotiable digital record evidencing a pro rata beneficial entitlement'; Regulation S
backpack.about: Tokenized stocks and ETFs on Solana (xStock). The holder gets a beneficial interest in a BVI bare-trust pool of shares, redeemable via Backpack Exchange. The token side is unregulated and disclaims security status (BVI FSC); SEC-registered broker-dealers sit only in the custody chain. Governed by BVI law (Issuer T&Cs) with the off-chain brokerage entitlement under New York law (UCC Art. 8).
backpack.source: Backpack Issuer T&Cs; RWA Sonar issuer dossier (Sep 2026, entity map, BVI governing law, NZ register 9406953)

sailing.name: Sailing Protocol
sailing.structure: Tokenized equities said to maintain reserves of the tracked stock; US persons restricted unless accredited
sailing.about: Small tokenized-equity project (tokens on Arbitrum) that describes itself as 'a technology company' and says it maintains stock reserves, but publishes no issuer entity, jurisdiction or prospectus. RootData marks the project inactive.
sailing.source: Sailing Protocol FAQ/About; RootData project entry (inactive); no legal entity located

st0x.name: ST0x
st0x.structure: German GmbH (Berlin); tokenised debt instruments each carrying a contractual right of exchange for one listed share; base prospectus approved by the Liechtenstein FMA
st0x.about: Issues tStock / wtStock — unsecured debt instruments of S01 Issuer GmbH, each with a right to exchange for one share; dividends are delivered via the wrapper. Offered to the public under a Liechtenstein FMA-approved base prospectus (notified across the EEA), not to US persons.
st0x.source: ST0x legal docs; S01 Issuer GmbH base prospectus (Liechtenstein FMA, ESMA entry BPWO-77)

anchored.name: Anchored (aStocks)
anchored.structure: British Virgin Islands company; aStocks are trust receipts under a bare trust over Anchored Finance SPC (segregated portfolio) fund shares
anchored.about: Issues aStocks — 1:1-backed ERC-20 tokens tracking single stocks, ETFs and ETPs. Each token is a beneficial entitlement under a bare trust over Anchored Finance SPC segregated-portfolio fund shares.
anchored.source: Anchored Capital Ltd BVI register (i-BVI); Anchored factsheets ('Issuer: Anchored Capital Ltd'); Ketju Research

solon.name: Solon
solon.structure: Single tokenized NVIDIA stock deployment (NVDA.sol) on Base
solon.about: One tokenized stock row (Solon NVDA, chain 5042). No public issuer entity, jurisdiction or prospectus was located.
solon.source: token-list row only; no public issuer documentation located

nest.name: Nest (Plume Vaults)
nest.entity: Nest DAO LLC; developed by Kimber Labs Inc. (d/b/a Plume)
nest.structure: Marshall Islands non-profit DAO LLC operating Nest Credit; each vault share is one LayerZero OFT over institutional private-credit, treasury and CLO funds
nest.country: Marshall Islands (Nest DAO LLC); Plume developed by Kimber Labs Inc. (Delaware, US)
nest.about: Plume's flagship RWA vault protocol. Vault shares (nTokens) wrap underlying tokenized funds including BlackRock iShares AAA CLO ETF, Apollo diversified credit, Goldfinch Prime and treasury products.
nest.source: Nest/Plume docs ('Developed by Kimber Labs Inc.'); LEI 254900CI5XNYLYYVY397 (Kimber Labs Inc., Delaware); AssetTokenization.com (Nest DAO LLC, Marshall Islands)

blackrock.name: BlackRock (iShares)
blackrock.structure: US public company; the underlying iShares ETFs are SEC-registered funds — but the tokenized rows are third-party wrappers over those ETFs, not BlackRock-issued tokens
blackrock.about: The 'blackrock' rows in the list are tokenized iShares ETFs (AGG, HYG, CLOA, TLT, …) wrapped by third-party issuers — Reality Finance 'rStock' and Anchored 'aStock' — so the tokenholder's counterparty is the wrapper, not BlackRock. BlackRock's own BUIDL money-market fund appears under the 'securitize' issuer in this list.
blackrock.source: token-list rows (rStock/aStock iShares names); RWA.xyz 'SP500 rStock' (Reality, realityfinance.xyz); Anchored factsheets; Securitize BUIDL

anemoy.name: Anemoy (Centrifuge)
anemoy.structure: British Virgin Islands segregated portfolio company; a professional fund licensed by the BVI Financial Services Commission
anemoy.about: Issues tokenized funds on Centrifuge, including the Janus Henderson Anemoy Treasury Fund (JTRSY) and AAA CLO Fund (JAAA), open to non-US professional investors.
anemoy.source: S&P Global Ratings (Anemoy Capital SPC Ltd, BVI SPC); Centrifuge pool page; LEI 2549009CBJ86SM12V633

midas.name: Midas
midas.structure: German GmbH (Berlin); issues blockchain-based certificates 'mTokens' under a base prospectus approved by the Liechtenstein FMA (Regulation (EU) 2017/1129)
midas.about: Issues mTBILL / mBASIS treasury certificates and other mTokens over US T-bills and third-party fund strategies; offered under a Liechtenstein FMA-approved base prospectus.
midas.source: Midas Software GmbH base prospectus (17 July 2026); MFSA Final Terms filings

securitize.name: Securitize
securitize.entity: Securitize, Inc.; Securitize Markets, LLC; Securitize Transfer Agent, LLC
securitize.structure: US Delaware corporation; SEC-registered transfer agent and FINRA/SEC-registered broker-dealer
securitize.about: Compliance infrastructure for tokenized securities; issues and administers BlackRock BUIDL, Hamilton Lane SCOPE, Apollo Diversified Credit and other private-credit and money-market funds.
securitize.source: Securitize ToS (Securitize, Inc., Delaware); SEC EDGAR filings

superstate.name: Superstate
superstate.structure: US SEC-registered investment adviser (New York); tokenized private funds (Delaware)
superstate.about: Manages USTB (Invesco Short Duration US Government Securities Fund) and USCC (crypto carry/basis fund) as tokenized private funds.
superstate.source: Superstate Advisers LLC Form ADV / SEC IAPD brochure

franklin.name: Franklin Templeton
franklin.entity: Franklin OnChain U.S. Government Money Fund (Franklin Templeton)
franklin.structure: US money-market fund (Delaware statutory trust), tokenized as BENJI (FOBXX)
franklin.about: BENJI is the first SEC-registered on-chain US government money-market fund, issued by Franklin Templeton.
franklin.source: rwaAssets.ts note (Franklin OnChain U.S. Government Money Fund); Franklin Templeton BENJI materials

vaneck.name: VanEck
vaneck.about: VBILL — the VanEck Treasury Fund, a tokenized US government-securities fund issued through Securitize.

circle.name: Circle (USYC / Hashnote)
circle.structure: US Delaware limited liability company; USYC is a tokenized money-market fund available only to non-US (Regulation S) qualified investors
circle.about: USYC (US Yield Coin) is Hashnote's tokenized money-market fund; Hashnote Holdings LLC was acquired 100% by Circle in January 2025.
circle.source: Circle USYC page; Circle 10-Q (Hashnote Holdings LLC, Delaware, acquired Jan 2025)

matrixdock.name: Matrixdock
matrixdock.structure: Singapore tokenization platform; XAUm = 1 troy ounce of 99.99% LBMA-certified gold
matrixdock.about: Issues XAUm, a tokenized gold product (1 token = 1 troy oz LBMA gold), part of the Matrixport Group.
matrixdock.source: OnChain Benchmark issuer profile (Singapore); Matrixdock docs

reservoir.name: Reservoir
reservoir.structure: Permissionless stablecoin protocol issuing rUSD; this repo classifies it as credit/reinsurance-backed
reservoir.about: Issues rUSD, which this repo tags as reinsurance/RWA-backed credit; Reservoir's own docs describe a multi-collateral stablecoin redeemable 1:1 for USDC/USDT/USD1. No single incorporated issuer is disclosed.

tether.name: Tether Gold
tether.structure: British Virgin Islands company; XAUt is backed by allocated physical gold
tether.about: XAUt (Tether Gold) is backed by allocated physical gold; issued by TG Commodities Limited, a Tether-affiliated BVI company.

paxos.name: Paxos Gold
paxos.structure: US New York limited-purpose trust company, regulated by the NYDFS
paxos.about: PAXG (Paxos Gold) is backed 1:1 by allocated physical gold; issued by Paxos Trust Company, a NYDFS-regulated limited-purpose trust.

unitas.name: Unitas
unitas.structure: British Virgin Islands company; XGLD is a yield-bearing gold asset backed by Tether Gold (XAUt) collateral
unitas.about: Unitas issues USDu and XGLD; XGLD is a yield-bearing gold asset backed by Tether Gold (XAUt) collateral with delta-neutral yield strategies.
unitas.source: Unitas docs; i-BVI company register (Unitas Foundation S.A.)

prestocks.name: PreStocks
prestocks.structure: Tokenized pre-IPO price-tracking tokens on Solana; attestations by BlockOffice Pte. Ltd. (Singapore)
prestocks.about: Pre-IPO tokens tracking private companies (SpaceX, OpenAI, Anthropic, Neuralink, …) on Solana. No incorporated issuer, SPV or counterparty is identified; the ToS describes 'a distributed network of contributors located around the world'.
prestocks.source: RWA Sonar (no incorporated issuer identified); PreStocks attestation report (BlockOffice Pte. Ltd., Singapore)

tessera.name: Tessera
tessera.entity: Dedicated issuer per token; segregated portfolios in a Cayman Islands SPC
tessera.structure: Loan participation rights with a non-security legal opinion under Singapore law
tessera.about: T-Tokens (tSpaceX, tOpenAI, tKalshi) are loan participation rights via a dedicated issuer entity and a segregated portfolio inside a Cayman SPC, giving economic exposure to private-share valuations. Repayment depends on a qualifying liquidity event.
tessera.source: Tessera blog 'How T-Tokens Are Actually Structured' (Cayman SPC, Singapore-law opinion)

shift.name: Shift (SHIFT DAO)
shift.structure: Marshall Islands for-profit series DAO LLC (Decentralized Autonomous Organization Act 2022); each leveraged/inverse product is a designated Series holding third-party daily-reset leveraged ETFs
shift.about: Issues leveraged and inverse tokenized stocks/indices on Solana (SPX3L, TSL2L, …). Each token is a membership interest in a Series whose treasury holds a daily-reset leveraged ETF (e.g. Direxion SPXL) via DekaBank and ALPACADB LTD custodians — synthetic exposure, no claim on the referenced share. Governed by Marshall Islands law.
shift.source: RWA Sonar issuer dossier (SHIFT DAO LLC, RMI, Series operating agreements, MINS LLC nominee)

vnx.name: VNX
vnx.structure: Liechtenstein company; VNXAU = 1 gram of allocated LBMA-certified gold
vnx.about: VNX Gold (VNXAU) — one gram of allocated physical gold held in Liechtenstein/Swiss vaults, with periodic agreed-upon-procedures reserve reports. (These rows carry no issuer slug in the list; identified from the token.)
vnx.source: VNX agreed-upon-procedures report (VNX Commodities AG, Vaduz)

dominion.name: Dominion
dominion.about: SILV was Dominion's tokenized physical silver. Dominion ceased operations after a September 2026 exploit; a pre-hack holder refund programme paid $63 per SILV. (These rows carry no issuer slug in the list.)
